description:
OneTone is a simple tone generator that plays a single tone at the frequency you choose.
Play any pitch instantly, from a deep 20 Hz to a high 20,000 Hz.
You can also pick a note such as A4 or C#5, or play chords such as C, G, and Am.

■ Great for
• A steady tone to help you focus while you work
• Checking your instrument's tuning against a 440 Hz reference tone
• Hearing how a chord sounds
• Testing how low and how high your speakers or headphones can go
• Learning how pitch and waveform change a sound, by ear and by eye

■ Features
• Frequency: 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz. Set it with the knob, the slider, or by typing a value
• Presets: recall 100 Hz / 440 Hz / 1 kHz / 10 kHz with a single button
• Frequency modes: switch between Hz, NOTE, and CHORD in Settings
• NOTE mode: pick a note such as A4 or C#5. The knob and slider move in semitones, so you always hear the exact pitch
• CHORD mode: press a pad such as C, G, or Am to play a major or minor chord, or combine a root note with Major or Minor
• Waveforms: choose from sine, square, triangle, and sawtooth
• Volume: adjust from 0 to 100% with a vertical fader
• Oscilloscope: see the waveform of the sound being played in real time
• Level meter: see the output level in real time
• Change the frequency, volume, or waveform while playing, and the sound stays smooth
• The tone fades out naturally when you stop it
• Your frequency, waveform, mode, and other choices are saved for next time. You can reset them to the defaults in Settings at any time
• Tutorial: a short guide shows you around the first time you open the app. Use the ? button to view it again at any time

■ Design
A black screen with glowing neon colors, inspired by DJ gear.
Choose your accent from eight theme colors. On iPhone and iPad, you can also choose the app icon in eight colors.
While playing, the buttons and logo glow and the bars in the logo move with the sound, so you can see at a glance that a tone is playing.
The layout switches between side by side and stacked to fit the width of the screen.
The Reduce Motion accessibility setting is also supported.

■ Languages
Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Indonesian

■ Caution
High frequencies and loud volumes can strain your ears and speakers. Start at a low volume.
If the volume was above 20% last time, the app lowers it to 20% at launch and lets you know, so you never get a sudden loud sound.
